channel.title: What's for Eats — practical dinner ideas
channel.description: Free dinner tools and guides for busy households.

item.title: What should I make for dinner? Try this free dinner finder
item.description: Too tired to decide what to cook? Choose your available time, effort and main ingredient to browse 12 practical dinner ideas with links to full recipes. Free to use, with no signup. Save it for your next busy evening.

item.title: 5-ingredient dinners for busy nights
item.description: Keep dinner simple with seven flexible recipes, measured ingredients and step-by-step directions. Find black bean sweet potatoes, cheesy bean quesadillas, pasta and more. Read the free guide and choose one meal for tonight.

item.title: A 7-night dinner plan for picky families
item.description: Take some of the guessing out of dinner with a flexible seven-night plan. Explore tacos, pasta, breakfast for dinner and build-your-own plates, with practical serving ideas. Read the free plan and adapt it to your family.
